offer: Holly knows the crash concealed John's escape. Discuss continuing the search and what records she can provide.
unavailable: Tell Holly about the staged disappearance before discussing this next lead.

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: I have thought about what you told me. I still want you to find John.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: Then we need a trail beyond the aircraft. The records show how he left, not where he went.

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: Would financial records help? There are payments and correspondence in my own files.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: They could give us leads. Can you supply copies of records you are authorized to share? Statements, receipts, payment references. No passwords.

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: Yes. I agree to provide copies from my records for this investigation.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: I will keep the source clear. Supplied copies are not unrestricted access to somebody else's bank account.

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: Understood. Do you need originals, or will copies do?

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: Start with copies and keep the originals. Half the agency still treats carbon paper as emerging technology.

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: All right. Please keep looking for him.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: The scope is recorded: documents Holly supplies for the investigation. No live account access, bank credentials or conclusion about her earlier knowledge has been established.

objective: Complete agency mission nine, then attend the agency's medical review.

messages.complete: Holly agreed to continue the search and supply financial-record copies. Next: mission nine, then the agency medical review.
